# EnvShield — Zero-Dependency Environment Security & Secret Leak Auditor

EnvShield audits repository .gitignore protection, detects leaked credentials with Shannon entropy and regex signatures, validates schema parity between .env and .env.example, and automatically sanitizes .env templates.

- Website: https://fastpresspages.github.io/envshield/
- Repository: https://github.com/fastpresspages/envshield
- License: Apache-2.0 (FastPress Labs)
- Zero runtime dependencies: Node >= 18.17 standard library only.
- Interfaces: CLI (`envshield`), stdio MCP Server (`envshield-mcp`), and composite GitHub Action.

## Key Capabilities
- `envshield audit [dir]`: Comprehensive audit of .gitignore protection, tracked env files, template leaks, and variable parity.
- `envshield scan <file>`: Scans text or files for AWS, GitHub, Stripe, OpenAI, Anthropic, Slack, DB URIs, and high-entropy secrets.
- `envshield check <env> --example <ex>`: Validates variable parity and types (`port`, `boolean`, `url`, `number`, `enum`).
- `envshield generate <env>`: Generates a sanitized `.env.example` template with safe placeholders.
- Stdio MCP server (`envshield-mcp`): Exposes `audit_env`, `scan_secrets`, `validate_env`, `generate_example` tools.
